name: mondapac-drive
description: Mondapac Drive: fleet management and last-mile delivery for the Mondapac marketplace (modular monolith).

scripts.build: pnpm db:generate && pnpm -r build && node scripts/check-built-kernel.mjs && node scripts/check-built-parser.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm db:generate && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm boundaries && pnpm test && pnpm test:db && pnpm db:check-reversible
scripts.boundaries: pnpm --filter @mondapac-drive/api boundaries && node scripts/check-prisma-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-panel-boundaries.mjs
